'''Hawkins''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Private/Legends|private]] who fought for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He was seriously injured during the [[Battle of Corellia]].
